summary: Validated backend social-card endpoint (Pillow PNG generator) + frontend share dialog with new 'Compartir directo' section. All 11 backend tests PASS and all 10 frontend testids present + interactive. Toggle Post/Story updates preview src correctly. WhatsApp/Facebook/Instagram/Native share buttons render, are clickable, and do not crash the app; Instagram + Native fallback toasts fire with the expected Spanish text.
critical_code_review_comments: recruiting.py L1623-1663 social-card endpoint: token accepted via Authorization header OR ?auth= query param — validated 401 without token, 401 with invalid token, 200 with either channel; JWT `type=refresh` correctly rejected. Good pattern for preview.
_build_social_card handles both photo/no-photo (placeholder) and eval/no-eval cases without 500 (verified via 4 combinations).
Aspect ratios validated with Pillow: post≈4:5 (delta<0.02) and story≈9:16 (delta<0.02).
ScoutingModule.js: previewUrl regenerates when previewFmt toggles Post↔Story — verified src changes from format=post to format=story and back.
shareFacebook shows a toast only when shareUrl is falsy; in the tested prospect the public share link is active, so clicking Facebook opens the sharer popup (no toast). This is expected behavior.
shareNative correctly falls back to download+toast when navigator.canShare/share is unavailable (as in headless Chromium).

Suggestion (non-blocking): the 'Link de Scouting público' Dialog wraps both public-link and card-preview + native-share section. Consider surfacing the Compartir button separately when there is no public link yet — currently clicking 'Compartir' auto-generates/loads the public link which is fine but changes state.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral: TEST_SocialCard_NoPhoto + TEST_SocialCard_WithPhoto prospects created and deleted by pytest module fixtures (module scope with teardown). Used existing prospect 'TEST_E2E_Prospect' for UI test (not modified).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend: Login as SuperAdmin, click sidebar 'Scouting' → click any prospect card → click data-testid='detail-share-btn'. Dialog 'Link de Scouting público' opens with sections: (a) public link + Abrir ficha/Desactivar; (b) TARJETA PARA REDES with brand form + Vista Previa (Post/Story toggles, live img preview via data-testid='card-preview-img', src carries ?auth=<jwt>&format=post|story); (c) Post(1:1.25) / Story(9:16) download buttons; (d) 'COMPARTIR DIRECTO - POST|STORY' with data-testid='native-share-wrap' containing share-native-btn, share-whatsapp-btn, share-facebook-btn, share-instagram-btn. Toggle preview-fmt-story updates preview src to format=story. Backend: pytest /app/backend/tests/test_social_card.py -v runs 11 cases in ~4s covering auth, formats, no-photo/photo, no-eval/eval, unknown pid 404 and aspect ratios.
